_what: Every credential a deploy holds (#2006). .env is each one's single home: bootstrap generates a value .env lacks, every secrets/ file is derived from .env, compose reads each from the environment with no default, and the doctor refuses a value the repository has committed. Read by scripts/dev/ops/deploy_credentials.py (bootstrap and deploy) and the doctor.

_fields.secret_file: the docker secret derived from it, or null
_fields.secret_format: how the secret file is written from the value ({value}); absent means the value itself
_fields.legacy: the value an existing deploy already runs with, adopted into .env when the variable is absent there, so a deploy that predates #2006 keeps working until it is rotated; null means a new value is generated even on an existing deploy
_fields.committed: values the repository has ever committed for it; the doctor refuses any of them
_fields.keycloak_client: the Keycloak client whose secret this is; the realm sync sets it from .env on every deploy
_fields.keycloak_user: the realm user whose password this is; the realm sync sets it from .env in every synced realm, unless the user already holds it

credentials.what: the Postgres squadops role (the deployment database's owner)
the Postgres squadops_test role (the integration suite, #1180)
the squadops-agent Keycloak client (the agents' client credentials)
the squadops-runtime Keycloak client (service accounts enabled)
the realm user squadops-admin (admin, operator and viewer) in every SquadOps realm (#2079)
Langfuse's API-key hashing salt (rotating it invalidates every Langfuse API key)
the Langfuse UI user bootstrap creates (admin@squadops.local)
